searchText: Probably relevant for devnet 2 https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/538 <@795439202732867594>, <@680234424037670912> mentioned that the bitmask should probably be little endian, since that's what the CL primarily uses. That should be fine, right? Can we just do `uint_to_bytes`? nvm the length of this function result is not guaranteed to be 4 bytes. I don't see anywhere in CL using big endian except for kzg related stuff Also I think it’s pretty odd that we have a separate nfd field instead of putting it inside the existed eth2 field. If we are concerned about decoding different ENRForkID container post-fulu, we can instead deprecate the entire eth2 field and define a new field which is a new ENRForkID with nfd in it. <@&1367819653279125645> are you all on board for https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7939 being in devnet2 scope? We have an implementation from Giulio in Geth, and it's a very simple/safe proposal, so I'm in favor. cc <@755913785620824175> We have to do this for backwards compatibility. cc <@795439202732867594> Also ACK from Reth side. FWIW, I’m against. I think we should only add CFI/SFI’d EIPs to fork devnets. That said, if we want to prototype it, we should at least separate that spec from Fusaka-devnet-2. <@&1367819082019377202> https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4373 <zilm13> Just random idea regarding mempool presentation: Does it make sense to make getBlobsV2 long polling? So EL doesn't drop connection immediately if all blobs are not available, instead waits up to 3 seconds and answers later or drops with empty response in 3 seconds? attestation deadline is 2 seconds > instead waits up to 3 seconds and answers later or drops with empty response in 3 seconds? what would i do with a response after 3 seconds, EL might as well not respond <zilm13> - If you already received your sampling DataColumnSidecars through gossip, you don't care - If not, it's the chance for this block to be included, pass DA check in Forkchoice and you could help distribute sidecars - 3 seconds is a random number, we could use another. Plus we request after 1st seen sidecar/block and 2 seconds is in slot time, right? Different start (re @amphora_interop_bot: <agnxsh> > instead waits up to 3 seconds and answers later or drops with empty response in 3 seconds? what would i do with a response after 3 seconds, EL might as well not respond) > So EL doesn't drop connection immediately if all blobs are not available but that would simply mean, we aren't really relying on getBlobs as much as we were before no? ie, we would get mostly everything from gossip <zilm13> The question is if it could improve successful hit rate but degrade the hit frequency but ok i get the justification makes sense How do we feel about this? https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4373 its a must Cool, will merge after some client approvals We already do it So yes from us can we have more spaced out bpo forks from the next devnet? more like 2 per day?

excerpts.author: jtraglia
excerpts.content: <@795439202732867594>, <@680234424037670912> mentioned that the bitmask should probably be little endian, since that's what the CL primarily uses. That should be fine, right?

excerpts.author: nc1234
excerpts.content: Can we just do `uint_to_bytes`?

excerpts.author: nc1234
excerpts.content: nvm the length of this function result is not guaranteed to be 4 bytes.

excerpts.author: nc1234
excerpts.content: I don't see anywhere in CL using big endian except for kzg related stuff

excerpts.author: nc1234
excerpts.content: Also I think it’s pretty odd that we have a separate nfd field instead of putting it inside the existed eth2 field. If we are concerned about decoding different ENRForkID container post-fulu, we can instead deprecate the entire eth2 field and define a new field which is a new ENRForkID with nfd in it.

excerpts.author: barnabasbusa
excerpts.content: <@&1367819653279125645> are you all on board for https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7939 being in devnet2 scope?

excerpts.author: .fjl
excerpts.content: We have an implementation from Giulio in Geth, and it's a very simple/safe proposal, so I'm in favor.

excerpts.author: jtraglia

excerpts.author: gakonst

excerpts.author: timbeiko
excerpts.content: FWIW, I’m against. I think we should only add CFI/SFI’d EIPs to fork devnets.

excerpts.author: timbeiko
excerpts.content: That said, if we want to prototype it, we should at least separate that spec from Fusaka-devnet-2.

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content:
<zilm13> Just random idea regarding mempool presentation:
Does it make sense to make getBlobsV2 long polling? So EL doesn't drop connection immediately if all blobs are not available, instead waits up to 3 seconds and answers later or drops with empty response in 3 seconds?

excerpts.author: agnxsh
excerpts.content: attestation deadline is 2 seconds

excerpts.author: agnxsh
excerpts.content:
> instead waits up to 3 seconds and answers later or drops with empty response in 3 seconds?
what would i do with a response after 3 seconds, EL might as well not respond

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content:
<zilm13> - If you already received your sampling DataColumnSidecars through gossip, you don't care
- If not, it's the chance for this block to be included, pass DA check in Forkchoice and you could help distribute sidecars
- 3 seconds is a random number, we could use another. Plus we request after 1st seen sidecar/block and 2 seconds is in slot time, right? Different start (re @amphora_interop_bot: <agnxsh> > instead waits up to 3 seconds and answers later or drops with empty response in 3 seconds?
what would i do with a response after 3 seconds, EL might as well not respond)

excerpts.author: agnxsh
excerpts.content:
> So EL doesn't drop connection immediately if all blobs are not available
but that would simply mean, we aren't really relying on getBlobs as much as we were before no? ie, we would get mostly everything from gossip
